sourceText: Operator (2026-07-05): turn the B-b550 audit's M7 follow-up scope (the six milestone-observability hardening items) into a single implementation story, and develop it all the way to DONE.
normalizedOutcome: milestone_status/closeout print an explicit observability-only disclaimer (NOT DONE/Authority/production); milestone_status command-policy reason mentions Authority; the milestone-status test suite runs in the aggregate suite with new passing negative controls (duplicate rows, vacuous confirmed ledger, stale-only closeout); confirmMilestoneLedger rejects a hash-mismatched confirm; not_applicable rows require a justification; and decision docs record the gate-mode-default (observe stays) and stale-evidence/second-gate reconciliation.
acceptanceClaim: lattice validate and the full npm test suite pass with all six M7 hardening items closed by code + tests + recorded decisions, and the diff is limited to packages/main plus decision docs (no contract weakening).
